record.description: ShareThis is a leader in social sharing intelligence, utilizing extensive data collection and analysis since 2007 to provide insights into social sharing behavior. By synthesizing data from various social platforms, ShareThis delivers actionable marketing intelligence for brands and publishers. Based in the United States, ShareThis also focuses on creating a positive workplace culture, evidenced by multiple awards for being a great place to work.
